name: DLF Ltd.
business_summary: India's largest listed real-estate developer by market value (Rs 1.83 lakh cr; promoter family 74.08%). Two engines: (1) residential development, concentrated in Gurugram/NCR luxury and super-luxury (Privana, Camellias/Magnolias-type, senior living) with a Rs 58,000 cr launch plan; (2) annuity rental via DLF Cyber City Developers (offices, ~96% leased) plus retail malls and some hospitality. Reported revenue is lumpy under completion-based recognition: Q2 FY27 sales Rs 1,261 cr, operating profit only Rs 23 cr, but PAT Rs 1,301 cr (JV share, other income, Rs 738 cr non-cash gain). Sales bookings Rs 3,800 cr in Q2. Net-cash balance sheet.

revenue_mix.geography: NCR, Mumbai, Chennai; DCCDL offices equity-accounted (screener interest only Rs 93 cr TTM)

exposures.mechanism: Residential development ~55-60% of DLF value, rental ~35-40% (model estimate; no segment NAV fetched). +10% market sales volume sustained -> DLF bookings +8% (luxury skew, supply-constrained Gurugram) -> development NAV +5% -> group value +3% (x0.55-0.6 weight), EV/MCap ~0.97 (net cash), persistence ~0.8 => ~+3.5. Context: Anarock top-7 city sales only +3% y/y in Jul-Sep 2026, so the cycle is flat not rising.

evidence.note: Anarock via Economic Times 2026-09-28: Jul-Sep 2026 housing sales +3% y/y to just over 1 lakh units across top 7 cities
Q2 FY27: PAT Rs 1,301 cr (+11%), revenue -23% y/y, sales bookings Rs 3,800 cr (Moneycontrol/Business Standard 2026-10-16); Rs 738 cr non-cash gain supported profit (Moneycontrol 2026-10-19)

exposures.mechanism: RBI hiked to 5.50% on 2026-10-07 (first hike in ~4 yrs). +25 bp: home-loan EMI +~2% -> luxury-skewed buyers low elasticity, presales -0.6% -> development NAV -0.4%; multiple/sentiment compression of a P/E-40 long-duration stock ~ -1.4%; net-cash balance sheet means no funding-cost hit (interest only Rs 93 cr TTM), small gain on treasury float (other income Rs 2,069 cr FY; +25 bp on ~Rs 10k cr = Rs 25 cr, <0.6% of PAT). Total ~ -2.0. Stock +11% in the month after the hike, so market is not yet pricing a hit.

evidence.note: Reuters/The Hindu 2026-10-07: RBI hiked repo 25 bp to 5.50% (first hike in ~4 years), stance 'calibrated tightening'; Governor says cuts off the table near term
India Today 2026-09-21: analysts see up to 50 bp more by December; The Hindu 2026-09-18: two hikes possible in CY2026 (pre-decision views)
Mcap Rs 1,83,458 cr, P/E 40, P/B 4.0, promoters 74.08%, FII 11.43% (falling from 13.54%), DII 9.06%; other income Rs 2,069 cr FY; interest Rs 93 cr TTM (net-cash profile)

exposures.mechanism: Cap-rate channel for annuity assets (DCCDL Cyber City/Cyber Hub offices + malls, ~35-40% of value): +25 bp G-sec -> required yield +12 bp (50% pass-through; rent yields ~7.5%) -> asset value -1.6% x 0.375 weight = -0.6; plus -1.0 on development NAV discount rate. Kept separate from repo (demand/funding) but flagged as a parallel path.
